exposure: Interval from the last cesarean section
HCG on the first day after operation
Decreasing rate of HCG on the first day after operation
outcome: Success of treatment for cesarean scar pregnancy
cohort: 32 women treated for cesarean scar pregnancy with local injection of Lauromacrogol combined with curettage.
finding: The interval from the last cesarean section and the decreasing rate of HCG were protective factors, while the mean diameter of gestational sac and period of vaginal bleeding before operation were risk factors for successful treatment of cesarean scar pregnancy.
